ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; high-intensity pixels are limited to <5% of the total visible area, primarily confined to the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 55-degree V-shaped angular depression with significant vertical depth relative to the lobe base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the posterior margin, characterized by multiple jagged peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvilinear sweep extending laterally from the central notch to the distal apexes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups localized on the extreme left and right lateral margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense biological encrustations (barnacles) on both lateral tips and several isolated high-contrast circular spots on the interior ventral surface.
